Project/submission/dispatcher_region.py does NOT ship that: it routes d_model<=128 to a fused-block megakernel and larger d_model to an fp16 tensor-core stack. k009_fused_tuned.py is that megakernel - its own header describes exactly what the dispatcher header describes, K1 norm plus packed QKV and K2 flash attention over all heads with the out-projection folded in, then residual, norm2, exact-erf GELU FFN and residual in-register, with the whole forward captured as one CUDA graph. k009 keeps activations in registers between fused stages instead of round-tripping HBM about ten times per layer, and holds weights in fp16 with fp32 accumulation, so it should beat k004 on every d_model<=128 shape.
